controller: unchanged 22D/2D G13 TD-MPC2, original H=3 task-only MPPI, unchanged Generic SOFA

arms.B0: Original raw G13 task reward and original lambda=0.5 auxiliary force-head loss
arms.B1: Same G13 architecture, optimizer starting state, auxiliary force-head loss and MPPI; only training navigation reward differs by one fixed normalized Generic distal-force FTI penalty

contact_penalty_definition: r_train = r_task - beta * (distal_force_time_integral_Ns / scale_Ns), where beta and scale_Ns must be fixed from training-only G13 data before rollout
seed_freeze_prerequisite: Audit every proposed seed against prior G0-G17/F2A-F2H training, validation, development, diagnostic, fork, planner-state and confirmation artifacts before a new pilot. Do not automatically replace conflicts.

matched_training.replay_label_strategy: BLOCKED_PENDING_DESIGN: G13 historical replay has raw task rewards and peak-force labels but not per-step FTI, so B1 FTI-shaped replay cannot be initialized by silently relabeling it. The B0/B1 strategy must be specified and checked before rollout.
matched_training.matched_initial_data_if_used: Must be the same prospectively collected G13 observations/actions/task rewards/FTI labels, segregated per arm and predeclared; no evaluation-case experience.

intermediate_checkpoints: Predeclare exact additional-step snapshots (for evaluation only) and separate restartable episode-boundary checkpoints; evaluate every scheduled snapshot, but select no favorable intermediate checkpoint. Primary comparison is the predeclared terminal-budget checkpoint.

evaluation.scene_lifecycle: One fresh Generic SOFA scene per checkpoint/evaluation arm, reused across identical ascending seeds; replay preceding seeds on interrupted evaluation, never skip ahead with a fresh scene.
force_metrics: per-step distal force FTI nominal N*s
evaluation.paired_uncertainty: Episode-paired confidence intervals grouped by independent evaluation seed; report training seeds separately.

scientific_stop_rules_before_future_run: Stop if zero-update B0/B1 behavior or checkpoint integrity differs from unchanged G13.
Stop if paired target identity or Generic force telemetry validity fails.
Stop if reward labels in either replay disagree with the declared arm semantics.
Report any B0 navigation degradation without blaming the B1 penalty.
Do not tune beta, replay, learning rate or select an intermediate checkpoint on the final/confirmation set.
F2H_execution: No model training, B1 implementation, full navigation benchmark, or confirmation run.
